prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years of account contributed to the syndicate loss for the year and led to strengthening of prior year reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net strengthening of prior year reserves of $1.4m in 2018. Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $385.8m and at 31 December 2018 were $307.4m (reflecting payments and movements during the year). Management attributes the prior year deterioration to adverse claims experience on the 2016 and earlier years of account, which contributed to the 2018 underwriting loss.
raw_causal_phrases: some adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years of account during the year
The syndicate has strengthened prior year reserves by $1.4m during 2018 (2017: release of $26.5m).
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement amount is provided in the notes. The report states a net strengthening of prior year reserves of $1.4m (text quoted). No dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found. A gross claims development table is present but only as development percentages plus current estimates; it does not provide earlier-period diagonals to compute gross PYD. Therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m above uses the reported net figure ($1.4m) and is NET of reinsurance; the figure is flagged as inferred/net and the confidence is reduced accordingly. All monetary figures are in the report's functional currency (USD).
